name: r8_read_002
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,os
p=Path.cwd(); pins=json.loads((p/'PINS.json').read_text())
for k in ['lean','leanchecker']:
 print(k,hashlib.sha256(Path(pins[k+'_bin']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),pins[k+'_sha256'])
print(subprocess.run([pins['lean_bin'],'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
print('PIN',json.dumps(pins))
b=json.loads((p/'BASELINE.json').read_text());print('BASELINE',json.dumps(b)[:8000])
for f in ['inputs/ROOT-AUTHORIZATION.json','inputs/previous-r7/CHECKPOINT.md']:
 print('FILE',f);print((p/f).read_text())
print('PROOFS', [str(x.relative_to(p)) for x in (p/'inputs').rglob('*') if x.is_file() and ('PROOF' in x.name or 'author' in str(x) or x.name in ['original-p1.txt','original-p3.txt'])][:80])
